messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Sorry galat number lag gaya tha, but aap ka intro dekh kar dil khush ho gaya 😊 Main Ahmed, Dubai mein kaam karta hoon.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Haha koi baat nahi. Main Sana.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Sana ji subah subah aap ki yaad aa gayi. Aaj din bohot acha ja raha hai alhamdulillah.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Aap to bohot sweet ho Ahmed 😄

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Sach kahoon, itne kam dinon mein kisi ko itna close mehsoos nahi kiya. Yeh baat sirf tum se share kar raha hoon, kisi ko na batana.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Aur suno, mere trading group mein gold signals se paisa double hota hai. Mere cousin ki car double ho gayi 2 mahine mein! Guaranteed profit hai risk zero.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Double?? Thora risky lagta hai sach mein.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Bilkul nahi! Screenshots dekh lo mere profits ke. Entry aaj last day hai, 50,000 is Easypaisa manager account par: 0345-XXXXX77.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Sirf 10 minute ke andar bhejo to VIP slot dilwa doonga. Time nahi hai jaan!
